name: zstd
description: Fast lossless compression algorithm with high compression ratios and rapid decompression

zstd.description: High-performance compression tool with excellent speed-to-compression ratio balance
zstd.usage:
zstd file.txt
zstd -d file.txt.zst
zstd -19 file.txt
zstd -c file.txt > compressed.zst
zstd -r directory/
